native_abi.00698a10: ECX configuration, no stack inputs, RET; new source prefix retains four real Lua objects for caller and stops before699AD8.
native_abi.00a93350: ECX fresh34h binding; stack descriptor14h pointer, required/forbidden0Ch header pointers, float scale; EAX fresh, RET10h.
native_abi.00a93070: ECX actual34h binding; no stack inputs/result; RET. Both arrays are resized to0 and freed, forbidden then required.
native_abi.00a93620: ECX actual30h action; stack descriptor, required, forbidden, float scale; RET10h. Constructs/appends/destroys temporary34h binding.
native_abi.00a93830: ECX actual24h owner; stack action index, descriptor, required, forbidden, float scale; RET14h. Computes captured action base+index*30h, delegatesA93620.

boundaries.script_modifier_prefix: Reuses existing AI/AJ concrete functions and real Lua objects, no alternative owner or parsed container.
boundaries.output: Actual action records/configuration and four retained caller-owned Lua objects; no setting520, final rebind, tick or settings call.
boundaries.scratch_padding: Native and C++ stack preimages differ. Descriptor11..13 and binding02..03 preserve their respective preimages; fixture comparisons must mask undefined scratch preimages.
boundaries.callbacks: Required action activation uses real source poll/listener code. A fixture may provide finite device services, but production must route reached calls to real devices.

recovered_behavior.groups: Iterate groups values into actual DWORD header, helper nil defaults0 otherwise Lua boolean, configure each action before appending bindings.
recovered_behavior.inputs: Probe each consecutive numeric entry for nil and destroy the probe, then fetch the same entry again; stop at the first nil.
recovered_behavior.bindings: press descriptor, optional and/not descriptors, nil-default mul from live one bits; static general/map flags gate modifier-list lookup, descriptor subsequently gates on live runtime/config flags.
recovered_behavior.inversion: Checked camera then plane membership with separate live config byte reads; each match performs x87 float*live double sign and stores binary32.
recovered_behavior.tail: After all Inputs, configure action128h with context1Eh and helper0. Free context storage; preserve Inputs value/key/table/globals for the remaining tail.

limitations: Final699AD8..699B7D rebind/update/settings/flag/cleanup schedule is not supplied by this prefix.
No original FH3, hardware faults, malformed negative array sizes, arbitrary stack aliases, native VFS routing or gameplay validation.

binding_states.00a93070: State0 releases required if forbidden destruction fails; reset before normal required destruction.
binding_states.00a93620: State0 owns temporary binding only after constructor returns; resets before normal destructor.
